title: Alex's Anti-Creeper Grief
body: Anti Creeper Grief is a simple quality-of-life datapack/mod that prevents Creepers from destroying blocks when they explode. Preserving the survival experience and challenge, but your builds, farms, storage rooms, and redstone contraptions remain safe from accidental destruction. Perfect for survival worlds, multiplayer servers, and long-term projects where protecting your creations is more important than repairing random Creeper damage. This keeps the game balanced while removing one of Minecraft's most frustrating mechanics.
